heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: Sikka Regency completed factual verification of 4,026 earthquake-damaged homes on 25 September, though more than 200 residents filed objections to their assigned damage category during the mandatory four-day public review process. The cumulative aftershock count reached 17,680 by 23 September — up nearly 2,000 from the 15 September mark — after a M4.5 shock near Ruteng caused no reported damage. Manggarai Timur's own verification stands at 26,185 units following its third emergency-status extension, running through 26 September.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
